answer: The admission bond is time locked for 17 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. Locks are written down in marble, expire in grove, and echo lists each expiry. A hostile operator running 132 aliases therefore needs 129 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. Each duplicate costs another 102 dollars in locked collateral and another 8 days of waiting. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
